example.title: Alfred Zampa Memorial Bridge (I-80 westbound over the Carquinez Strait)

brief: US 30 over the Miami River (West Coast). Modelled on the Alfred Zampa Memorial Bridge, the first major US suspension bridge built since the 1960s: a 728 m main span between two hollow concrete towers (a pair of tapered legs joined by two cross struts), a streamlined steel orthotropic box deck, 45 m clearance, with a bike and pedestrian path. Here: a 300 m main span, anchorages on the banks, box-girder approaches over the basin. Foundations: large-diameter steel pipe piles and drilled shafts 30 m below the modelled bed.
